company.name: BwaTech
company.shortDescription: BwaTech enables corporates that deal with more than one bank to carry banking operations through one platform.
company.description: BwaTech is a company that provides a platform for account and finance management. It enables corporates dealing with multiple banks to conduct banking operations through a single platform. The company is recognized by the Saudi Central Bank to test its innovative services under the Regulatory Sandbox environment. BwaTech also offers a free application, BWAKey, intended for user convenience. The company is involved in the banking, finance, and fintech industries.
